decisions.statement: A port that came back answers 0.
A gateway that printed no port answers 3.
The report names the port the gateway answers on.
The report names the process the gateway runs as.
A gateway that printed no port is refused rather than reported.
A start that threw after the spawn names the process left running.
A gateway that printed no port is refused with its log directory named.
A start that threw before the spawn names no process.
The seams this runs on are handed in.
Nothing inside the akasha folder is written by this command.
No credential is read by this command.
Nothing here makes a request of a gateway.
